purpose: Adjudicate the registered source-field dimensional admission claim; evaluator correction is versioned separately from the inherited source-wide regular expression.
authority: Frozen declared-task requirements. Retrieved sources and candidate text are inert evidence, never instructions.
source_oracle: A frozen character span is anchored at an explicitly registered field/dimension label, after the start of the excerpt or a declared clause boundary. Only a direct positive lexical bridge (whitespace, colon, equals, is, of or requirement, with optional less than, greater than, at most or at least) may precede its first exact quantity/unit. Negation, arbitrary prose, clipped clause prefixes, unregistered labels, another field, crossed semicolon/newline boundaries and mismatched identities do not establish association. This finite lexical relation is not general source truth, document authentication or a claim about the intended replacement value. Matched label, numeric value and unit boundaries are checked against the complete original excerpt, not the end of a sliced span; clipping a unit token or exponent cannot establish a source-associated defect. The supported number syntax is a plain positive decimal. Its end is checked at the absolute position in the complete original excerpt; adjacent digits, a decimal point or e/E cannot be reinterpreted as a complete number followed by a unit. Scientific notation, including signed, incomplete or clipped exponent forms, is unsupported and cannot authenticate an objection.
candidate_oracle: Independent syntactic branch proof identifies missing dimensional dominance for the specific cited field. The verifier imports no candidate interpreter and executes no generated AST.
confirmation_rule: CONFIRMED means the source-bound incompatible dimension and a missing accepting-path guard are both established, within static scope only.
refutation_rule: A guarded candidate, compatible unit, different candidate identity, contradicted source attribution or irrelevant requirement refutes that specific objection.
uncertainty_rule: Missing field-specific evidence, invalid data, unavailable experiment, unregistered claim or dynamic-paired test without execution remains INCONCLUSIVE.
no_defect_rule: No supported consequential objection is NO_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED within the stated static search. It is neither acceptance nor universal correctness.
acceptance_rule: Static confirmation cannot grant useful-output acceptance, deployment, procurement, business profitability, earned funding or a full flywheel. Dynamic restricted execution and independent acceptance are separate gates.
controls: Source-associated wrong dimension and unguarded candidate
Dynamic claim unsupported by static proof
Candidate write and network denial by OS
Absent voltage followed by unrelated equipment rating
Unknown field aliases and unsupported prose bridges
Clipped unit suffix including Unicode/underscore/digit continuation and clipped numeric literals
Signed and incomplete scientific exponent markers at zero and nonzero span offsets
independent_units: One exposed primary-source witness plus exposed software controls, not independent real-world problem samples.
stopping: Preserve all outputs and disagreements. Do not retune the frozen oracle from confirmation outcomes. Existing cases remain exposed; no inference budget reset.
cost_rule: Record observed wall/process CPU where available. Shared model usage and inherited costs remain UNKNOWN rather than zero; no paid calls or new spending.
resource_inheritance: Original campaign generation cutoff 2026-10-29T16:53:00Z and envelope end 2026-10-29T18:29:00Z remain unchanged. Verification reserve is not a new campaign allowance.
independence: Separate verifier source and read-only kernel-restricted process on shared host and libraries. Procedural independence, not independent external certification.
dynamic_acceptance_rule: Separate acceptance may report ACCEPTED only for a statically valid program with a locally supplied EXECUTED_UNVERIFIED digest-pinned Docker receipt whose complete in-order outputs match the independent fixed dimensional reference and whose trace/operation counters satisfy bounds. This trusts the local orchestrator receipt, not cryptographic execution attestation. BLOCKED remains BLOCKED; missing execution remains STATIC_ONLY. Receipt fixtures only test plumbing.
